explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/399: 'Cambie has also observed that considerations modulo 8 rule out any solutions to n! = x^4 + y^4 with (x,y) = 1 and xy > 1.' The Lean statement is exactly: for naturals n, x, y with gcd(x,y) = 1 and 1 < x·y, n! ≠ x^4 + y^4. It is proved in the file (for n ≤ 3, n! ≤ 6 < 16 ≤ x^4 + y^4; for n ≥ 4, 8 | n! while x^4 + y^4 ≡ 1 or 2 mod 8 as x, y are not both even), matching the mod-8 argument. Faithful.
